findings.definition: CHECK ((status = 'draft') OR ((body_sha IS NOT NULL) AND (sent_at IS NOT NULL) AND (rendered_body IS NOT NULL) AND ((source_kind = 'text') OR (source_document_id IS NOT NULL))))
findings.why: voidContract (src/contracts/send.mjs:429-450) sets status='void'. The moment status stops being 'draft', the constraint's second branch must hold — but a never-sent draft has sent_at NULL, body_sha NULL and rendered_body NULL, so the UPDATE violates the constraint and surfaces as a 500 write_failed. This is why ONLY never-sent drafts fail to void; a sent contract voids fine because it already has all three artifact fields.

findings.why: api/payment-links.mjs:35 sets PAYMENT_LINK_ROLES = ROLE_SETS.FINANCE and gates on it at line 75. 'closer' is not in that set, so a closer gets 403 forbidden. 'closer' IS in ROLE_SETS.STAFF (line 139). Whether a closer SHOULD be allowed to create a pay link is a product decision — see questions.

findings.rootCause: src/register-all.mjs subscribes nothing to contract.signed or contract.sent
findings.why: The word 'contract' does not appear anywhere in src/register-all.mjs (46 lines, 10 register* calls: Lifecycle, Comms, PaymentLinks, MoneyChain, CustomerInsights, InquiryGate, InquiryDocs, CommasDisputes, DiagnosticSoftPull, AgentRuntime). src/events/canonical.mjs:87-89 declares both contract.sent and contract.signed as canonical names, and src/contracts/sign.mjs:515 emits contract.signed — into a bus with no subscriber.

findings.rootCause: product_aliases has no alias for any current offer name except the legacy diagnostic one
findings.why: Title matching is data-driven through product_aliases (14 rows). The only alias matching a real checkout title is 'Business Financial Assessment' -> diagnostic. The live payment_links descriptions 'UnderwriteIQ soft-pull assessment', 'Credit repair, done-for-you', 'Repair test run (first round, done for you)' and 'Prove e-book $1' have NO alias row, and the offer names 'UnderwriteIQ Deliverables Package' and 'Funding Mastery course (A to Z)' have none either. Every real commas event whose title DID match ('Business Financial Assessment') produced a diagnostic.paid; the newer titles produce only payment.received. That is the mechanism behind T2-09, and it is fixable as data plus a matcher change.

findings.rootCause: src/payment-links/index.mjs:70-76 throws commas_not_configured only when no checkout config resolves
findings.why: The throw is the last else of a three-branch chain: mint a Commas session, else build a URL from checkoutBaseUrl, else fail 503. 40 links were created successfully on 2026-08-16 through this same code, so the code path is sound and the 2026-08-18 503 reflects the live environment lacking the config it needs. Confirming WHICH env var the live site is missing requires reading Netlify's production env, which CLAUDE.md §11 says is blocked (api.netlify.com 403 at CONNECT). Not retried.
A case-insensitive grep for 'payment-link', 'pay link', 'paymentLink' and 'create.*pay' over the whole file returns zero matches. There is not a hidden or disabled button — there is nothing at all.

MAP has 6 keys (SOFT_PULL, FUNDING_DFY, REPAIR_DFY, REPAIR_TRIAL, UWIQ_DELIVERABLES, FUNDING_MASTERY) while OWN_CODES lists 5 catalog codes — that is T2-10, and it matches entitlement_catalog exactly (5 rows). REPAIR_DFY and REPAIR_TRIAL both map to 'metro2-letter-pack' — that is T2-14, verbatim at lines 1329 and 1330.
